subject.title: fix(memory): report indexed vector store in status

question: Should plain `openclaw memory status` report vector-store readiness from persisted `vectorDims` metadata while `--deep` remains the live sqlite-vec probe?
rationale: The patch is technically sound, but it changes the meaning of a user-visible status field from live process readiness to persisted prior-index readiness on the fast path.

options.title: Accept Metadata-Backed Fast Status
options.body: Land this PR if maintainers agree that plain status should show prior successful vector indexing and reserve live sqlite-vec loadability for `--deep`.

options.title: Require Live-Probe Wording
options.body: Revise the status output or JSON shape before merge if `Vector store: ready` must only mean current-process sqlite-vec loadability.

options.title: Pause For A Different Contract
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and pause this PR if maintainers want a different status contract or a larger memory diagnostics redesign.

recommendation.title: Accept Metadata-Backed Fast Status
recommendation.body: Land this PR if maintainers agree that plain status should show prior successful vector indexing and reserve live sqlite-vec loadability for `--deep`.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent is the current assignee on the PR and has release-state provenance for the latest shipped behavior.
